cards.name: Ampharos
cards.description: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail’s light.

cards.name: Wormadam Sandy Cloak
cards.description: When BURMY evolved, it cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.

cards.name: Burmy Plant Cloak
cards.description: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

cards.name: Burmy Sandy Cloak
cards.description: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

cards.name: Corsola
cards.description: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can’t live in polluted waters.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.description: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.description: It uses the horns on its head to sense human emotions. It is said to appear in front of cheerful people.

cards.name: Sentret
cards.description: It has a very nervous nature. It stands up high on its tail so it can scan wide areas.

cards.name: Spinda
cards.description: No two SPINDA have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.

cards.name: Gallade
cards.description: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on it elbows.

cards.name: Latias
cards.description: Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisble.

cards.name: Latios
cards.description: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.

cards.name: Mothim
cards.description: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by COMBEE.

cards.name: Delibird
cards.description: It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has the habit of sharing food with people lost in mountains.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.description: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fire hair that zaps on impact.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.description: It is highly perceptive of its Trainer’s feelings. It dances when it is feeling happy.

cards.name: Stantler
cards.description: Staring at its antlers creates an odd sensation as if one were being drawn into their centers.
